messages:
maria_support: Customer reports no welcome credits after signup. Email verified, 3DS completed, billing addr in Madrid (ES). Visa ****4321. Ticket CS-12044 for acct acct_ES_9923 — can someone triage?

kevin_billing: can you drop pm last4, BIN, and signup ts? also region/browser if known. pinging @payments-bot for webhook events.

maria_support: last4: 4321; bin: 451754; signup_ts: 2265004321; region: eu; billing_country: ES. User says 3DS flow showed success.

payments-bot: webhook events (seq):
- payment_method.created @2265004322
- 3ds.completed @2265004325 (status=success)
- autogrant.eval @2265004326 -> result: gated
  reasons: [pm_country_bin_mismatch, geo_ip_vs_billing]

fraud_ops: quick check against bindb v2025-11: bin 451754 resolves to GB. That triggers pm_country != billing_country rule. If BIN should be ES, looks like our DB is stale.

sam_eng: I reproduced the autogrant check locally. Repro steps: 
1) curl -X POST https://internal.api/autogrant/check -d '{"account":"acct_ES_9923"}'
2) response: {"allowed": false, "reasons": ["pm_country_bin_mismatch"]}

Query accounts: `select auto_grant_enabled, region, billing_country from accounts where id='acct_ES_9923';` -> `true | eu | ES`
So settings look good; evaluator used bindb mapping that set country=GB.

kevin_billing: can we refresh bindb and re-evaluate queued autogrants? Also we should persist the gating reason on the account note so support can see why it was blocked.

sam_eng: will patch bindb to latest (v2026-03-10) and re-run eval for this account. Adding telemetry to attach gating_reason to autogrant decision and logging which lookup (bindb vs geolocation) triggered it. Also adding a backfill to re-run autogrant for accounts with successful 3DS in last 48h.

fraud_ops: recommendation for immediate unblock: manual grant of welcome credits (10 units) and mark as false positive. I can approve override if support executes.

maria_support: executed manual grant: `grant_credits acct_ES_9923 10 --reason "manual_override:bindb_fp"` -> success. Left note on account and notified customer: "Credits applied, apologies — this was a BIN lookup mismatch and we're fixing it." :white_check_mark:

payments-bot: bindb refresh completed @2265007200; re-eval for acct_ES_9923 -> allowed: true; reasons: []

sam_eng: root cause = stale BIN DB entry for 451754. Remediations: pushed bindb update, scheduled daily bindb refresh job, added autogrant telemetry + account note, created backfill job for recent successful 3DS events, tracked in ENG-1387.

kevin_billing: also request: add an alert when >5% of EU autogrant failures in 1h are due to pm_country_bin_mismatch. File follow-up with SRE.

maria_support: customer replied: "Thanks — credits visible, all good now." Closing CS-12044. :tada:
